definition: To be in charge of people, work or money.
exampleSentence: She will manage a team of eight developers from next month.

definition: To arrange a time for something to happen.
exampleSentence: Let us schedule the next meeting for Thursday at ten o'clock.

definition: To officially agree to something.
exampleSentence: The manager has to approve all expenses over five hundred euros.

definition: To officially give a document or request.
exampleSentence: Please submit your weekly timesheet before five o'clock on Friday.

definition: To check something carefully, often to improve it.
exampleSentence: Could you review my report before I send it to the client?

definition: To put a plan, system or idea into action.
exampleSentence: The IT team will implement the new password policy next month.

definition: To discuss something in order to reach an agreement.
exampleSentence: We need to negotiate a better price with our main supplier.

definition: To organize people or activities so they work well together.
exampleSentence: Anna will coordinate the move to the new office.

definition: To give part of your work to someone else.
exampleSentence: Good managers delegate tasks instead of doing everything themselves.

definition: To decide which tasks are the most important.
exampleSentence: When everything is urgent, you need to prioritize your tasks carefully.

definition: To improve something by replacing it with a newer version.
exampleSentence: We plan to upgrade all office computers to the latest system.

definition: To be present at a meeting or event.
exampleSentence: All team leaders must attend the training session on Monday.

definition: To plan and arrange something.
exampleSentence: Our HR department will organize a team dinner next Friday.

definition: To study something in detail to understand it.
exampleSentence: The data team will analyze last year's sales figures.

definition: To make something better.
exampleSentence: We changed the checkout page to improve the customer experience.

definition: To create or build something over time.
exampleSentence: Our company plans to develop a mobile version of the app.

definition: To keep something in good condition or working.
exampleSentence: It takes a small team to maintain our old billing system.

definition: To bring or hand over a product, service or result.
exampleSentence: We promised to deliver the first version to the client in June.

definition: To succeed in reaching a goal.
exampleSentence: The sales team worked hard to achieve its yearly target.

definition: To need something, often officially.
exampleSentence: All visitors require a badge to enter the server room.

definition: To give someone a task or job.
exampleSentence: The project manager will assign each bug to a developer.

definition: To say that something is true or definitely happening.
exampleSentence: Please confirm your attendance by replying to this email.

definition: To decide that a planned event will not happen.
exampleSentence: We had to cancel the client visit because of the storm.

definition: To guess an amount, cost or time based on information.
exampleSentence: Can you estimate how long the new feature will take?

definition: To judge how good or useful something is.
exampleSentence: We will evaluate three different tools before we buy one.

definition: To give someone a job.
exampleSentence: The company plans to hire twenty new engineers this year.

definition: To teach someone the skills for a job.
exampleSentence: Senior staff will train the new employees during their first week.

definition: To start a new product, service or project.
exampleSentence: The company will launch its new app at the conference in May.

definition: To put money or time into something to get a benefit later.
exampleSentence: Many companies invest heavily in cybersecurity training for their staff.

definition: To make something smaller or less.
exampleSentence: Moving to the cloud helped us reduce our hardware costs.

definition: To find the answer to a problem.
exampleSentence: The support team needed three hours to solve the printer problem.

definition: To talk about something with other people.
exampleSentence: We will discuss the new budget at tomorrow's team meeting.

definition: To show and explain something to an audience.
exampleSentence: I will present the project results to the board on Friday.

definition: To suggest a plan or idea formally.
exampleSentence: I would like to propose a new process for handling support tickets.

definition: To work together with others.
exampleSentence: Designers and developers collaborate closely on every new feature.

definition: To follow the progress of something over time.
exampleSentence: Our app lets managers track the progress of every task.

definition: To put new software or equipment in place so it can be used.
exampleSentence: You need admin rights to install new programs on your work laptop.

definition: To find a solution to a problem or disagreement.
exampleSentence: The help desk aims to resolve most tickets within one day.

definition: To call, email or message someone.
exampleSentence: Please contact the IT department if you forget your password.

definition: To find and fix problems in a system.
exampleSentence: Restarting the router is the first step when you troubleshoot network problems.
